docs/getting-started.md:code-comment:tom.source: chat 模式模型；不注入工具
docs/getting-started.md:code-comment:tom.translation: Model for chat mode; do not inject tools

docs/getting-started.md:code-comment:tom.source: work 模式模型；启用工具
docs/getting-started.md:code-comment:tom.translation: Model for work mode; enable tools

docs/getting-started.md:list:1f8707173a9.source: 同一份配置只能运行一个本地实例。
docs/getting-started.md:list:1f8707173a9.translation: Only one local instance can run with the same configuration.

docs/getting-started.md:list:5eab595f9cc.source: 锁文件位于实际配置旁（如 __ELBOT_CODE_0__），正常关闭或异常退出后自动释放，无需手动清理；
docs/getting-started.md:list:5eab595f9cc.translation: The lock file is located next to the actual configuration (e.g., __ELBOT_CODE_0__) and is automatically released after a normal shutdown or abnormal exit, requiring no manual cleanup;

docs/getting-started.md:list:69c4098d844.source: service 模式不启动本地交互界面；没有配置消息平台、或全部平台均已退出时仍保持运行，直到外部停止。
docs/getting-started.md:list:69c4098d844.translation: service mode does not start the local interactive interface; it remains running even if no messaging platforms are configured or all platforms have exited, until stopped externally.

docs/getting-started.md:list:72f935361ba.source: 自动模式未显式指定 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时，只有 CLI 被禁用、没有任何连接配置、或默认本机服务拨号失败才回退本地启动；配置、认证和握手错误直接报告。
docs/getting-started.md:list:72f935361ba.translation: In auto mode, when __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is not explicitly specified, it will only fall back to local startup if the CLI is disabled, there are no connection configurations, or the default local service dialing fails; configuration, authentication, and handshake errors are reported directly.

docs/getting-started.md:list:9aeb3950039.source: 运行期间不要删除，保存或替换配置文件不影响已取得的锁。
docs/getting-started.md:list:9aeb3950039.translation: Do not delete it during operation; saving or replacing the configuration file does not affect the lock already acquired.

docs/getting-started.md:list:d41e5b6aeb1.source: 正常退出是秒级；卡住时最多等 30 秒，到时强制关闭。
docs/getting-started.md:list:d41e5b6aeb1.translation: Normal exit takes seconds; if stuck, wait up to 30 seconds before forcing a shutdown.

docs/getting-started.md:list:d85e496fbeb.source: 一个 LLM 服务：兼容 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 或 Responses API 之一（例如 DeepSeek、OpenAI）。
docs/getting-started.md:list:d85e496fbeb.translation: An LLM service: compatible with either __ELBOT_CODE_0__ or the Responses API (e.g., DeepSeek, OpenAI).

docs/getting-started.md:list:e1ec1575bc4.source: 至少一个可用 API Key。
docs/getting-started.md:list:e1ec1575bc4.translation: At least one available API Key.

docs/getting-started.md:list:f1ef45c164f.source: 直接启动的交互 CLI 退出时会结束所属应用进程。
docs/getting-started.md:list:f1ef45c164f.translation: When the directly started interactive CLI exits, the associated application process will terminate.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:088f65.source: **不想默认启用工具**：把 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 改为 __ELBOT_CODE_2__，需要工具时再 __ELBOT_CODE_3__。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:088f65.translation: **Do not want to enable tools by default**: Change __ELBOT_CODE_1__ of __ELBOT_CODE_0__ to __ELBOT_CODE_2__, and then __ELBOT_CODE_3__ when tools are needed.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:16008e.source: 只有在没有显式 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 时才自动生成平台默认配置；
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:16008e.translation: Platform default configurations are automatically generated only when there are no explicit __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__;

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:1a4adb.source: 运行数据（SQLite、日志、sandbox）默认进入平台数据目录。完整规则见 [配置说明](configuration.md)。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:1a4adb.translation: Runtime data (SQLite, logs, sandbox) goes into the platform data directory by default. See [Configuration Instructions](configuration.md) for the full rules.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:2f0427.source: 首次运行且平台配置目录没有 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时，会自动生成 __ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__、__ELBOT_CODE_3__、__ELBOT_CODE_4__、__ELBOT_CODE_5__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_6__；
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:2f0427.translation: When running for the first time and __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is missing from the platform configuration directory, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__, __ELBOT_CODE_3__, __ELBOT_CODE_4__, __ELBOT_CODE_5__, and __ELBOT_CODE_6__ will be automatically generated;

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:370dda.translation: Existing files will not be overwritten.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:3f2c56.source: **模型不可用或名称不对**：检查 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 是否存在于 __ELBOT_CODE_2__、__ELBOT_CODE_3__ 是否被该 Provider 支持；
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:3f2c56.translation: **Model unavailable or incorrect name**: Check if __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ exists in __ELBOT_CODE_2__, and if __ELBOT_CODE_3__ is supported by the Provider;

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:404eea.source: 密钥放在系统环境变量，或把自动生成的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 复制为配置目录下的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 后填写；不要直接写进 __ELBOT_CODE_2__。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:404eea.translation: Place the keys in system environment variables, or copy the automatically generated __ELBOT_CODE_0__ to __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in the configuration directory and then fill it in; do not write them directly into __ELBOT_CODE_2__.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:591b1c.source: 显式指定的路径不存在会直接报错。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:591b1c.translation: An error will be thrown directly if an explicitly specified path does not exist.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:746a4d.source: 换 Provider 时同步修改 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 只能手动改，其他设置可以在 CLI 里用命令设置。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:746a4d.translation: When changing the Provider, update __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__ simultaneously. __ELBOT_CODE_2__ can only be modified manually; other settings can be configured using commands in the CLI.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:82038a.source: 默认配置已包含 DeepSeek 和 OpenAI：
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:82038a.translation: The default configuration already includes DeepSeek and OpenAI:

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:97dafa.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 按当前环境变量猜测 shell。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:97dafa.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ guesses the shell based on the current environment variables.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:9a0842.source: 运行态模型写在配置目录的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__：
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:9a0842.translation: The runtime model is specified in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ in the configuration directory:

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:b72e97.source: 目标：配好 API Key，启动 CLI，完成第一次对话。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:b72e97.translation: Goal: Configure the API Key, start the CLI, and complete your first conversation.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:c8b09f.source: 主配置查找顺序：__ELBOT_CODE_0__ → __ELBOT_CODE_1__ → 平台配置目录（Windows __ELBOT_CODE_2__，Linux XDG 配置目录）。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:c8b09f.translation: Main configuration lookup order: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ → __ELBOT_CODE_1__ → platform configuration directory (Windows __ELBOT_CODE_2__, Linux XDG configuration directory).

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:f866e5.source: **启动时报 API Key 缺失**：检查 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 是否写对、系统环境变量或配置目录 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 是否包含对应 Key、当前 shell 能否读取这些变量。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:f866e5.translation: **API Key missing error at startup**: Check if __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is correct, whether the system environment variables or configuration directory __ELBOT_CODE_2__ contain the corresponding Key, and whether the current shell can read these variables.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:fec1d1.source: 也可以启动后用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 或 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 重载厂商配置并刷新模型列表。
docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:fec1d1.translation: You can also use __ELBOT_CODE_0__ or __ELBOT_CODE_1__ after startup to reload the provider configuration and refresh the model list.

docs/getting-started.md:paragraph:fed7a4.translation: For more commands, see [Command Quick Reference](commands.md).

docs/getting-started.md:table:079c06778a.source: 宽屏模式下调整两侧宽度，本次运行期间保留
docs/getting-started.md:table:079c06778a.translation: Adjust the width of both sides in widescreen mode; settings are preserved for the current run

docs/getting-started.md:table:0af7d364f1.translation: Full Foreground: Local CLI interface + enabled platforms + background tasks

docs/getting-started.md:table:0c50b16a53.source: 补全并引用本地文件；文件不存在时保留原文，按普通 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 文本发送
docs/getting-started.md:table:0c50b16a53.translation: Complete and reference local files; if the file does not exist, keep the original text and send it as plain __ELBOT_CODE_0__ text

docs/getting-started.md:table:0dcb54cb1b.source: 无界面服务：已启用平台 + 后台任务，按配置提供 CLI 服务端
docs/getting-started.md:table:0dcb54cb1b.translation: Headless Service: Enabled platforms + background tasks, provides CLI server based on configuration

docs/getting-started.md:table:397b3fedcb.source: 自动：优先连接 CLI 服务端，符合条件时回退本地启动
docs/getting-started.md:table:397b3fedcb.translation: Auto: Prioritize connecting to the CLI server, fallback to local startup when conditions are met

docs/getting-started.md:table:3d71768ae4.translation: Enter copy mode for chat area / notification area

docs/getting-started.md:table:921cbc18c7.translation: Drag the vertical line between the chat area and the notification area

docs/getting-started.md:table:c39afd62d8.translation: Switch between low-cost chat mode / work mode with tool usage
